title: Implement cell surface caching (biggest FPS win)
details: Cache cell surfaces per (cls, radius) pair in cell.py. Invalidate cache on refresh_class(). draw_at() currently creates a new SRCALPHA Surface + concentric gradient circles per cell per frame. This is the single largest rendering cost.
notes: Implemented cell surface caching in cell.py. Added module-level _cell_surface_cache dict + _get_cached_cell_surface() helper (lines 138-170) that caches gradient surfaces per (cls, radius, energy_band, selected). Modified Cell.draw_at() (line 1071) to use cached surface instead of allocating new SRCALPHA Surface + drawing r concentric circles every frame. Energy quantized to 5 bands for visual fidelity; cache capped at 2000 entries. All tests passed: syntax, import, 6 targeted cache tests, 6s headless sim run.
